title: Weighted averages of $p$-adic hypergeometric functions and traces of Frobenius of elliptic curves
summary: In this paper, we aim to study traces of Frobenius of certain one parameter families of elliptic curves and their relationships with $p$-adic hypergeometric functions. For example, we consider a DIK family of curves and establish the trace of Frobenius as weighted averages of special values of certain families of $p$-adic hypegeometric functions, where the average is taken over the arrays of parameters.
